Also, I'm curious about the Body Mass Index (BMI) of a person who weighs 85 kilograms and is 180 centimeters tall using the metric system. Lastly, could you calculate the BMI of another person who weighs 200 pounds and is 6 feet 2 inches tall using the imperial system?"
